notes_for_editor: Only a state number, an OpenStreetMap tag set, a county list entry and a general note on Hickman County wooden towers were found. Name, elevation and county match across tnlandforms and OpenStreetMap (coordinates about 35 m apart). No build date, designer, staffing, fire, access or visit record. Status standing is from tnlandforms with no date. The nomination's table of towers extant as of March 26, 2014 also lists Hornertown. The nomination does not say whether Hornertown was one of the wooden towers. Designer and construction type are from OSM tags only.
